_comment: Weight manifest. Weights are NEVER committed to this repo -- they are fetched
from Hugging Face at install time by scripts/fetch-models.py.
Every entry is pinned to a commit SHA rather than 'main'. A floating pointer
means a user installing tomorrow gets different weights from one installing
today, with no way to tell which they have when a bug is reported.
Licences are recorded per model because the installer generates the
attribution screen from this file. If you add a model, add its licence.

cpu.label: Any laptop, no GPU required
cpu.note: Indic output is romanized/transliterated, not mixed-script.

gpu.label: GPU with 3 GB+ VRAM
gpu.note: Same model, GPU-accelerated. Mixed-script needs the server tier.

asr-en.label: English speech recognition
asr-en.attribution: English ASR: streaming Zipformer by k2-fsa (Next-gen Kaldi)

indic-conformer-int8.label: Indic speech recognition (8 languages)
indic-conformer-int8.attribution: Indic ASR: AI4Bharat Indic Conformer (ONNX conversion by meetsync)

languages._comment: Hindi and Urdu are deliberately mutually exclusive at onboarding. They are phonetically near-identical and differ mainly in script, so a model asked to choose between them silently writes the wrong script rather than erroring. Letting the user declare one removes the model's weakest decision.

cleanup-llm.label: Filler removal, punctuation, capitalisation
cleanup-llm.attribution: Text cleanup: Qwen3-0.6B by Alibaba Cloud

install_sizes._comment: What a user actually downloads, by what they pick at onboarding.
